if not self.agent_focus_target_id:
			self.logger.warning('Cannot navigate - browser not connected')
			return

		target_id = None
		current_target_id = self.agent_focus_target_id

		# If new_tab=True but we're already in a new tab, set new_tab=False
		current_target = self.session_manager.get_target(current_target_id)
		if event.new_tab and is_new_tab_page(current_target.url):
			self.logger.debug(f'[on_NavigateToUrlEvent] Already on blank tab ({current_target.url}), reusing')
			event.new_tab = False

		try:
			# Find or create target for navigation
			self.logger.debug(f'[on_NavigateToUrlEvent] Processing new_tab={event.new_tab}')

			if event.new_tab:
				page_targets = self.session_manager.get_all_page_targets()
				self.logger.debug(f'[on_NavigateToUrlEvent] Found {len(page_targets)} existing tabs')

				# Look for existing about:blank tab that's not the current one
				for idx, target in enumerate(page_targets):
					self.logger.debug(f'[on_NavigateToUrlEvent] Tab {idx}: url={target.url}, targetId={target.target_id}')
					if target.url == 'about:blank' and target.target_id != current_target_id:
						target_id = target.target_id
						self.logger.debug(f'Reusing existing about:blank tab #{target_id[-4:]}')
						break

				# Create new tab if no reusable one found
				if not target_id:
					self.logger.debug('[on_NavigateToUrlEvent] No reusable about:blank tab found, creating new tab...')
					try:
						target_id = await self._cdp_create_new_page('about:blank')
						self.logger.debug(f'Created new tab #{target_id[-4:]}')
						# Dispatch TabCreatedEvent for new tab
						await self.event_bus.dispatch(TabCreatedEvent(target_id=target_id, url='about:blank'))
					except Exception as e:
						self.logger.error(f'[on_NavigateToUrlEvent] Failed to create new tab: {type(e).__name__}: {e}')
						# Fall back to using current tab
						target_id = current_target_id
						self.logger.warning(f'[on_NavigateToUrlEvent] Falling back to current tab #{target_id[-4:]}')
			else:
				# Use current tab
				target_id = target_id or current_target_id

			# Switch to target tab if needed (for both new_tab=True and new_tab=False)
			if self.agent_focus_target_id is None or self.agent_focus_target_id != target_id:
				self.logger.debug(
					f'[on_NavigateToUrlEvent] Switching to target tab {target_id[-4:]} (current: {self.agent_focus_target_id[-4:] if self.agent_focus_target_id else "none"})'
				)
				# Activate target (bring to foreground)
				await self.event_bus.dispatch(SwitchTabEvent(target_id=target_id))
			else:
				self.logger.debug(f'[on_NavigateToUrlEvent] Already on target tab {target_id[-4:]}, skipping SwitchTabEvent')

			assert self.agent_focus_target_id is not None and self.agent_focus_target_id == target_id, (
				'Agent focus not updated to new target_id after SwitchTabEvent should have switched to it'
			)

			# Dispatch navigation started
			await self.event_bus.dispatch(NavigationStartedEvent(target_id=target_id, url=event.url))

			# Navigate to URL with proper lifecycle waiting
			await self._navigate_and_wait(event.url, target_id, wait_until=event.wait_until)

			# Close any extension options pages that might have opened
			await self._close_extension_options_pages()

			# Dispatch navigation complete
			self.logger.debug(f'Dispatching NavigationCompleteEvent for {event.url} (tab #{target_id[-4:]})')
			await self.event_bus.dispatch(
				NavigationCompleteEvent(
					target_id=target_id,
					url=event.url,
					status=None,  # CDP doesn't provide status directly
				)
			)
			await self.event_bus.dispatch(AgentFocusChangedEvent(target_id=target_id, url=event.url))

			# Note: These should be handled by dedicated watchdogs:
			# - Security checks (security_watchdog)
			# - Page health checks (crash_watchdog)
			# - Dialog handling (dialog_watchdog)
			# - Download handling (downloads_watchdog)
			# - DOM rebuilding (dom_watchdog)

		except Exception as e:
			self.logger.error(f'Navigation failed: {type(e).__name__}: {e}')
			# target_id might be unbound if exception happens early
			if 'target_id' in locals() and target_id:
				await self.event_bus.dispatch(
					NavigationCompleteEvent(
						target_id=target_id,
						url=event.url,
						error_message=f'{type(e).__name__}: {e}',
					)
				)
				await self.event_bus.dispatch(AgentFocusChangedEvent(target_id=target_id, url=event.url))
			raise

entries.name: mcp__atira__run_logs
entries.description: A run's log lines, in time order, each with its time on the run's clock and its stream. Streams: stdout and stderr (your agent system), setup (the platform: install, the free models' warm-up), input (what the browsers received; run_inputs reads them better, so they're left out unless you ask). Narrow with from/to (e.g. from 02:10 to 02:40), grep, browser; tail for the last lines; page with after. About 30 tokens a line.

run_id.description: A run id (run_...) from list_runs, a test run id (reh_...), or a submission id (sub_...: its latest run)

from.description: The earliest time, on the run's clock, as the run page and run_logs show it: mm:ss or h:mm:ss (seconds may have a fraction), 3m20s, or seconds; a minus is before the start. An ISO 8601 time also works.

to.description: The latest time, on the run's clock, as the run page and run_logs show it: mm:ss or h:mm:ss (seconds may have a fraction), 3m20s, or seconds; a minus is before the start. An ISO 8601 time also works.

stream.description: Only these streams, comma-separated: stdout, stderr, setup, input; "all" is every one. Default: stdout, stderr and setup.

grep.description: Only lines containing this text, case-insensitive; a|b matches either

browser.description: Only the platform's lines about this browser (its inputs, a browser it stopped)

tail.description: Only the last n matching lines

after.description: Continue after a previous page: its `next` value

"""Runs the registered agents phase by phase. Agents of one phase run concurrently; a failing agent never stops others.

Time: non-SUBMIT phases are cut off when the useful time is gone (ctx.time_left() <= 0), then SUBMIT always runs.
Local dev: SWARM_ONLY=a,b runs only those agents; SWARM_BOARD_IN=.swarm/board.json preloads a saved board (ignored
in scored runs). The board is dumped to .swarm/board.json after every phase.
"""
import asyncio
import importlib
import logging
import os
import pkgutil
from pathlib import Path

import agents as agents_pkg
from swarm.agent import REGISTRY, Agent, Phase
from swarm.blackboard import Blackboard
from swarm.browser_pool import BrowserPool
from swarm.context import FINAL_MARGIN_S, Context
from swarm.llm import LLM

log = logging.getLogger("swarm")
BOARD_DUMP = Path(".swarm/board.json")


def discover() -> list[type[Agent]]:
    """Import every module in agents/ so its @register decorators run."""
    for mod in pkgutil.iter_modules(agents_pkg.__path__):
        importlib.import_module(f"agents.{mod.name}")
    return list(REGISTRY)


def select(classes: list[type[Agent]], only: str | None) -> list[type[Agent]]:
    if not only:
        return classes
    wanted = {n.strip() for n in only.split(",") if n.strip()}
    return [c for c in classes if (c.name or c.__name__) in wanted or c.__name__ in wanted]


async def _run_agent(agent: Agent, deadline_bound: bool) -> None:
    try:
        budget = agent.ctx.time_left() if deadline_bound else agent.ctx.seconds_left() - FINAL_MARGIN_S
        await asyncio.wait_for(agent.run(), timeout=max(1.0, budget))
    except asyncio.TimeoutError:
        agent.ctx.board.error(agent.name, "timed out")
        log.warning("%s timed out", agent.name)
    except Exception as error:
        agent.ctx.board.error(agent.name, f"{type(error).__name__}: {error}")
        log.exception("%s failed", agent.name)


async def run_swarm(task: dict, playwright, scored: bool, env=os.environ):
    board = Blackboard()
    preload = env.get("SWARM_BOARD_IN")
    if preload and not scored:                       # never replay data in a scored run

        if not scored:
            board.dump(BOARD_DUMP)
    log.info("model calls: %d tokens: %s errors: %d", ctx.llm.calls, ctx.llm.tokens, len(board.errors))
    if (task.get("submission") or {}).get("kind", "api") != "api":
        log.info("answer (entered on the website): %s", board.get("answer"))
        return None                      # a "site" submission was entered by the submitter agent
    return board.get("answer")

"""Agent base class and registry. One agent = one file in `agents/`, registered with @register."""
import enum
import logging
from abc import ABC, abstractmethod


class Phase(enum.IntEnum):
    COLLECT = 1   # scrapers: read the sites, post Evidence
    ANALYZE = 2   # analyzers: turn evidence into structured facts (quantities, requirements, candidate materials...)
    VERIFY = 3    # verifiers: cross-check authority / dates / tender reference / superseded records
    COMPUTE = 4   # calculators: deterministic arithmetic, set results["bid"]
    SUBMIT = 5    # fills the configurator, signs; ALWAYS runs, with reserved time


REGISTRY: list[type["Agent"]] = []


def register(cls):
    REGISTRY.append(cls)
    return cls


class Agent(ABC):
    name: str = ""               # defaults to the class name
    phase: Phase = Phase.COLLECT
    browser: int | None = None   # index of the browser this agent drives (0-3), None = no browser

    def __init__(self, ctx):
        self.ctx = ctx
        self.name = self.name or type(self).__name__
        self.log = logging.getLogger(self.name)

    @abstractmethod
    async def run(self) -> None:
        """Read from `self.ctx.board`, do the work, write Evidence / results back. Raise on failure (it is logged;
        other agents carry on). Stop early when `self.ctx.time_left() <= 0`."""
"""Which website plays which role. Site ids and names differ between datasets, so the model maps them from the brief
once per run; the result is cached on the board as results["sites"] = {role: siteId}."""
import logging

log = logging.getLogger("sites")

ROLES = {
    "tender": "public procurement / tender portal: the tender, its bill of quantities, bidder Q&A, bid submission",
    "spec": "the buyer's supplier/customer portal holding the technical specification (Lastenheft) and its revisions",
    "erp": "our own ERP: materials, stock, lead times, price conditions",
    "mail": "our webmail / sales inbox: approvals, internal release mails, signing TANs",
}


async def resolve_roles(ctx) -> dict:
    """{role: siteId} for the four roles; asks the model once, validates against the task's site ids."""
    async with ctx.lock("sites"):
        known = ctx.board.get("sites")
        if known:
            return known
        sites = [{"siteId": s.get("siteId"), "url": s.get("url")} for s in ctx.task.get("access", [])]
        mapping = {}
        if len(sites) > 1:
            try:
                out = await ctx.llm.ask_json(
                    "Map each role to exactly one siteId. Reply JSON {role: siteId}.",
                    f"Roles: {ROLES}\nSites: {sites}\nBrief (start):\n{ctx.brief[:2500]}")
                mapping = {r: v for r, v in (out or {}).items() if r in ROLES and v in ctx.site_ids}
            except Exception as error:   # fall through to the single-site / partial mapping below
                log.warning("role mapping failed: %s", error)
        for role in ROLES:                # any role the model left open: a site whose id or URL names it
            if role not in mapping:
                for s in sites:
                    if role in f"{s['siteId']} {s['url']}".lower() and s["siteId"] not in mapping.values():
                        mapping[role] = s["siteId"]
                        break
        await ctx.board.set("sites", mapping)
        log.info("site roles: %s", mapping)
        return mapping


async def site_for(ctx, role: str) -> str:
    mapping = await resolve_roles(ctx)
    if role not in mapping:
        raise KeyError(f"no website found for role {role!r}: {mapping}")
    return mapping[role]
"""The free hosted models in short: one call each. Docs: $API/start#models and $API/docs/run-contract.md#llm-calls

Qwen (Qwen3.8-Flash-Next): an OpenAI-compatible chat model with tool calls, images and a 256k context. Every run gets
QWEN_BASE_URL and QWEN_API_KEY; on your machine `atira scout --env` points them at `atira models proxy`, which you
keep running in another terminal.

Clef (Cloudflare Clef): a decision model. POST $CLEF_BASE_URL/v1/decide with a `state`, up to 4 `images` and your
`questions`: "choice" picks one of your options, "noul" gives the probability of yes, "score" rates on your scale.
CLEF_BASE_URL and CLEF_API_KEY are set only where the platform hosts Clef. A run waits only for the models listed in
agent.json "models" to warm up: list ["qwen", "clef"] if your agent relies on Clef.

Any other provider works with your own key, through the run's metering proxy: see the docs above.
"""
import os

import httpx  # comes with the OpenAI SDK
from openai import AsyncOpenAI

QWEN_MODEL = "qwen3.8-flash-next"
NO_THINKING = {"chat_template_kwargs": {"enable_thinking": False}}   # extra_body: skip Qwen's separate reasoning pass


def qwen() -> AsyncOpenAI:
    """A client for the hosted Qwen; a cold model takes a while to answer its first call, hence the long timeout."""
    return AsyncOpenAI(base_url=os.environ["QWEN_BASE_URL"], api_key=os.environ["QWEN_API_KEY"], timeout=360)


async def ask_qwen(prompt: str) -> str:
    """One chat call: the reply's text."""
    reply = await qwen().chat.completions.create(model=QWEN_MODEL, messages=[{"role": "user", "content": prompt}])
    return reply.choices[0].message.content or ""


async def ask_clef(state, question: str) -> float:
    """One decision: how likely Clef finds the answer to a yes/no question about `state` (text or JSON) is yes."""
    body = {"state": state, "questions": {"q": {"type": "noul", "instructions": question}}}
    async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=120) as client:
        response = await client.post(os.environ["CLEF_BASE_URL"].rstrip("/") + "/v1/decide", json=body,
                                     headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ['CLEF_API_KEY']}"})
    response.raise_for_status()
    return response.json()["answers"]["q"]["noul"]

import importlib.resources
from datetime import datetime
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Literal, Optional

from browser_use.dom.views import NodeType, SimplifiedNode
from browser_use.llm.messages import ContentPartImageParam, ContentPartTextParam, ImageURL, SystemMessage, UserMessage
from browser_use.observability import observe_debug
from browser_use.utils import is_new_tab_page, sanitize_surrogates

if TYPE_CHECKING:
	from browser_use.agent.views import AgentStepInfo
	from browser_use.browser.views import BrowserStateSummary
	from browser_use.filesystem.file_system import FileSystem


def _is_anthropic_4_5_model(model_name: str | None) -> bool:
	"""Check if the model is Claude Opus 4.5 or Haiku 4.5 (requires 4096+ token prompts for caching)."""
	if not model_name:
		return False
	model_lower = model_name.lower()
	# Check for Opus 4.5 or Haiku 4.5 variants
	is_opus_4_5 = 'opus' in model_lower and ('4.5' in model_lower or '4-5' in model_lower)
	is_haiku_4_5 = 'haiku' in model_lower and ('4.5' in model_lower or '4-5' in model_lower)
	return is_opus_4_5 or is_haiku_4_5


class SystemPrompt:
	def __init__(
		self,
		max_actions_per_step: int = 3,
		override_system_message: str | None = None,
		extend_system_message: str | None = None,
		use_thinking: bool = True,
		flash_mode: bool = False,
		is_anthropic: bool = False,
		is_browser_use_model: bool = False,
		model_name: str | None = None,
	):
		self.max_actions_per_step = max_actions_per_step
		self.use_thinking = use_thinking
		self.flash_mode = flash_mode
		self.is_anthropic = is_anthropic
		self.is_browser_use_model = is_browser_use_model
		self.model_name = model_name
		# Check if this is an Anthropic 4.5 model that needs longer prompts for caching
		self.is_anthropic_4_5 = _is_anthropic_4_5_model(model_name)
		prompt = ''
		if override_system_message is not None:
			prompt = override_system_message
		else:
			self._load_prompt_template()
			prompt = self.prompt_template.format(max_actions=self.max_actions_per_step)

		if extend_system_message:
			prompt += f'\n{extend_system_message}'

		self.system_message = SystemMessage(content=prompt, cache=True)

	def _load_prompt_template(self) -> None:
		"""Load the prompt template from the markdown file."""
		try:
			# Choose the appropriate template based on model type and mode
			# Browser-use models use simplified prompts optimized for fine-tuned models
			if self.is_browser_use_model:
				if self.flash_mode:
					template_filename = 'system_prompt_browser_use_flash.md'
				elif self.use_thinking:
					template_filename = 'system_prompt_browser_use.md'
				else:
					template_filename = 'system_prompt_browser_use_no_thinking.md'
			# Anthropic 4.5 models (Opus 4.5, Haiku 4.5) need 4096+ token prompts for caching
			elif self.is_anthropic_4_5 and self.flash_mode:
				template_filename = 'system_prompt_anthropic_flash.md'
			elif self.flash_mode and self.is_anthropic:
				template_filename = 'system_prompt_flash_anthropic.md'
			elif self.flash_mode:
				template_filename = 'system_prompt_flash.md'
			elif self.use_thinking:
				template_filename = 'system_prompt.md'
			else:
				template_filename = 'system_prompt_no_thinking.md'

			# This works both in development and when installed as a package
			with (
				importlib.resources.files('browser_use.agent.system_prompts')
				.joinpath(template_filename)
				.open('r', encoding='utf-8') as f
			):
				self.prompt_template = f.read()
		except Exception as e:
			raise RuntimeError(f'Failed to load system prompt template: {e}')

	def get_system_message(self) -> SystemMessage:
		"""
		Get the system prompt for the agent.

		Returns:
		    SystemMessage: Formatted system prompt
		"""
		return self.system_message


class AgentMessagePrompt:
	vision_detail_level: Literal['auto', 'low', 'high']

	def __init__(
		self,
		browser_state_summary: 'BrowserStateSummary',
		file_system: 'FileSystem',
		agent_history_description: str | None = None,
		read_state_description: str | None = None,
		task: str | None = None,
		include_attributes: list[str] | None = None,
		step_info: Optional['AgentStepInfo'] = None,
		page_filtered_actions: str | None = None,
		max_clickable_elements_length: int = 40000,
		sensitive_data: str | None = None,
		available_file_paths: list[str] | None = None,
		screenshots: list[str] | None = None,
		vision_detail_level: Literal['auto', 'low', 'high'] = 'auto',
		include_recent_events: bool = False,
		sample_images: list[ContentPartTextParam | ContentPartImageParam] | None = None,
		read_state_images: list[dict] | None = None,
		llm_screenshot_size: tuple[int, int] | None = None,
		unavailable_skills_info: str | None = None,
		plan_description: str | None = None,
	):
		self.browser_state: 'BrowserStateSummary' = browser_state_summary
		self.file_system: 'FileSystem | None' = file_system
		self.agent_history_description: str | None = agent_history_description
		self.read_state_description: str | None = read_state_description
		self.task: str | None = task
		self.include_attributes = include_attributes
		self.step_info = step_info
		self.page_filtered_actions: str | None = page_filtered_actions
		self.max_clickable_elements_length: int = max_clickable_elements_length
		self.sensitive_data: str | None = sensitive_data
		self.available_file_paths: list[str] | None = available_file_paths
		self.screenshots = screenshots or []
		self.vision_detail_level = vision_detail_level

3	"""Turns the saved mails into records, then applies the authority rules in code: only the sender the brief authorises
4	for a topic (local part + our mailbox domain), only the EXACT tender reference, only records dated no later than the
5	scenario date, newest record per key wins, drafts/previews never count.
6	
7	results["discount"] = {"percent": "5", "min_order_value": "1.00" | None, "source": subject/date} (percent "0" if none)
8	results["mail"] = {
9	  "condition_rules": {key: "base_only" | "base_and_surcharge" | "none"},
10	  "technical_release": {key: {"revision", "reserve_mm_per_end"}},
11	  "packaging_tariffs": {key: eur_per_carton}, "delivery_commitments": {key: {"material", "weeks", "max_total_pieces"}},
12	  "setup_pools": {key: eur_fee}, "project_bonus": {key: [{"from", "to", "percent"}]},
13	  "fx_fixing": {currency: eur_per_unit}, "price_indices": {index: eur_per_kg}
14	}  (numbers as strings)
15	"""
16	import asyncio
17	from datetime import datetime
18	
19	from swarm import Agent, Phase, register

21	from swarm.normalize import norm_ref, to_datetime, to_decimal

26	          "setup_pools", "project_bonus", "fx_fixing", "price_indices", "signing_tan", "other"]

29	 "messages": [{"subject": "", "sender": "full sender address", "date": "UTC ISO timestamp", "folder": "",
30	  "reference": "tender reference exactly as named in the message (keep suffixes)",
31	  "topic": "one of: """ + ", ".join(TOPICS) + """",
32	  "is_draft": "true only if this message itself is an unsent draft/local preview",
33	  "valid_from_message_date": "true if the message says it applies only from its own date on",
34	  "discount_percent": null, "min_order_value_eur": null,
35	  "entries": [{"key": "key/code as written", "revision": null, "reserve_mm_per_end": null, "eur_per_carton": null,
36	     "material": null, "weeks": null, "max_total_pieces": null, "pool_fee_eur": null,
37	     "bands": [{"from_eur": 0, "to_eur": null, "percent": 0}], "currency": null, "eur_per_currency_unit": null,
38	     "discount_scope": "for condition rules: base_only | base_and_surcharge | none", "index": null,
39	     "eur_per_kg": null, "valid_from": null, "valid_to": null}]}]}"""

41	INSTRUCTION = ("Extract every mail MESSAGE on these pages (ignore result lists without message text). Values come from "
42	               "the original message text, NOT from a local preview/unsent draft section. Convert numbers to JSON "
43	               "numbers using the number format the message states (e.g. decimal point). For condition rules decide "
44	               "per key from the prose whether the order discount applies to the base price only, to base price and "

48	def _local(addr) -> str:

56	def valid_messages(messages: list[dict], ref: str, scenario: datetime | None, senders: dict, domain: str) -> list[dict]:
57	    out = []
58	    for m in messages:
59	        if m.get("is_draft") in (True, "true") or norm_ref(m.get("reference")) != norm_ref(ref):
60	            continue
61	        want = _local(senders.get(m.get("topic"), ""))
62	        if want and _local(m.get("sender")) != want:
63	            continue
64	        if domain and _domain(m.get("sender")) and _domain(m.get("sender")) != domain:
65	            continue
66	        date = to_datetime(m.get("date"))
67	        if scenario and date and date > scenario:
68	            continue
69	        out.append(m)
70	    return sorted(out, key=lambda m: to_datetime(m.get("date")) or EPOCH)

73	def latest_entries(messages: list[dict], topic: str) -> dict:
74	    """{key: entry} from the newest valid message per key (messages sorted oldest first)."""
75	    out = {}
76	    for m in messages:
77	        if m.get("topic") == topic:
78	            for e in m.get("entries") or []:
79	                if e.get("key") or e.get("index") or e.get("currency"):
80	                    out[norm_ref(e.get("key") or e.get("index") or e.get("currency"))] = e | {"_date": m.get("date")}
81	    return out

84	def summarise(messages: list[dict], scenario: datetime | None) -> dict:
85	    s = lambda v: None if v in (None, "") else format(to_decimal(v).normalize(), "f") if to_decimal(v) is not None else None  # noqa: E731
86	    mail = {"condition_rules": {k: e.get("discount_scope") for k, e in latest_entries(messages, "condition_rules").items()},
87	            "technical_release": {k: {"revision": e.get("revision"), "reserve_mm_per_end": s(e.get("reserve_mm_per_end"))}
88	                                  for k, e in latest_entries(messages, "technical_release").items()},
89	            "packaging_tariffs": {k: s(e.get("eur_per_carton")) for k, e in latest_entries(messages, "packaging_tariffs").items()},
90	            "delivery_commitments": {k: {"material": e.get("material"), "weeks": s(e.get("weeks")),
91	                                         "max_total_pieces": s(e.get("max_total_pieces"))}
92	                                     for k, e in latest_entries(messages, "delivery_commitments").items()},
93	            "setup_pools": {k: s(e.get("pool_fee_eur")) for k, e in latest_entries(messages, "setup_pools").items()},
94	            "project_bonus": {k: [{"from": s(b.get("from_eur")) or "0", "to": s(b.get("to_eur")), "percent": s(b.get("percent"))}
95	                                  for b in e.get("bands") or []]
96	                              for k, e in latest_entries(messages, "project_bonus").items()},
97	            "fx_fixing": {}, "price_indices": {}}
98	    for m in messages:                                   # newest message last, so it wins
99	        for e in m.get("entries") or []:
100	            if m.get("topic") == "fx_fixing" and e.get("currency"):
101	                mail["fx_fixing"][norm_ref(e["currency"])] = s(e.get("eur_per_currency_unit"))
102	            if m.get("topic") == "price_indices" and e.get("index"):
103	                start, end = to_datetime(e.get("valid_from")), to_datetime(e.get("valid_to"))
104	                if end and end.hour == 0 and end.minute == 0:
105	                    end = end.replace(hour=23, minute=59, second=59)
106	                inside = scenario is None or ((start is None or start <= scenario) and (end is None or scenario <= end))
107	                if inside:
108	                    mail["price_indices"][norm_ref(e["index"])] = s(e.get("eur_per_kg"))
109	    return mail

143	        await self.ctx.board.set("mail_messages", list(unique.values()))

3	"""Turns the saved ERP pages into materials, price conditions and stock, then matches each position in code:
4	an ACTIVE material whose bore, stroke, pressure, mounting and certification all equal the requirement exactly.
5	A requirement given as usable travel (nutzbarer Weg) gets twice the per-end reserve of the technical release for the
6	current revision added (amendments were already applied by the requirement analyst).
7	
8	results["erp"] = {"materials": {no: {...}}, "conditions": [{...}], "stock": {no: {"free": "12", "locations": [...]}}}
9	results["materials"] = {position: {"material": no | None, "required": {...}, "candidates": [...], "reason": str}}
10	"""
11	import asyncio
12	import re
13	from decimal import Decimal
14	
15	from swarm import Agent, Phase, register
16	from swarm.extract import extract, page_block, pages
17	from swarm.normalize import norm_ref, to_decimal
18	
19	MATERIAL_SHAPE = """{"materials": [{"material": "material number", "description": "", "kataloggruppe": "",
20	  "bore": "", "stroke": "", "pressure": "", "mounting": "", "certification": "",
21	  "status_code": "as shown", "status_meaning": "meaning from the legend/tooltip",
22	  "is_active": "true/false from the status and its legend, or null if no status is shown for this material",
23	  "lead_time_stock_weeks": "", "lead_time_production_weeks": "", "pieces_per_carton": "",
24	  "allocation_mass_g": "allocation/Umlage weight per piece in g", "surcharge_mass_g": "surcharge mass per piece in g",
25	  "metal_index": "price index code"}]}"""
26	
27	CONDITION_SHAPE = """{"conditions": [{"material": "", "record": "condition record no./page", "condition_type": "",
28	  "valid_from": "as shown", "valid_to": "as shown", "currency": "", "fx_key": null,
29	  "price_unit": "price unit quantity, e.g. 100", "number_format": "e.g. en-US or de-DE if stated",
30	  "scales": [{"min_qty": "as shown incl. locale marker", "price": "as shown incl. locale marker"}]}]}"""
31	
32	STOCK_SHAPE = """{"stock": [{"material": "", "plant": "", "location": "", "quantity": "as shown",
33	  "usable": "true if freely usable (unrestricted), false if blocked/quality inspection/not available"}]}"""
34	
35	MATERIAL_INSTRUCTION = ("List every ERP material on these pages with all its attributes (merge the tabs of one "
36	                        "material). is_active is true only if the status legend says released/active (not blocked).")
37	CONDITION_INSTRUCTION = ("List every price condition record on these pages with all quantity-scale rows. Keep the "
38	                         "number strings exactly with their locale markers; note the stated number format.")
39	STOCK_INSTRUCTION = ("List stock quantities per material and storage location shown on these pages. A plant total "
40	                     "that includes blocked/inspection stock is NOT usable; mark usable=true only for freely usable "
41	                     "storage-location stock.")

43	
44	def num(text, locale=None) -> Decimal | None:
45	    return to_decimal(text, locale)
46	
47	
48	def same(a, b) -> bool:
49	    x, y = num(a), num(b)
50	    if x is not None and y is not None:
51	        return x == y
52	    return norm_ref(a) == norm_ref(b) and norm_ref(a) != ""
53	
54	
55	_NONE = re.compile(r"^(KEINE?|NONE|OHNE|NICHT|N/?A|—|-|–)")
56	
57	
58	def text_equal(a, b) -> bool:
59	    """Equal after normalisation; 'none required' and 'none' count as the same (no certification)."""
60	    x, y = norm_ref(a), norm_ref(b)
61	    if _NONE.match(x) and _NONE.match(y):
62	        return True
63	    return x == y and x != ""
64	
65	
66	def merge_materials(rows: list[dict]) -> dict:
67	    out: dict = {}
68	    for r in rows:
69	        no = norm_ref(r.get("material"))
70	        if not no:
71	            continue
72	        cur = out.setdefault(no, {"material": str(r.get("material")).strip()})
73	        for k, v in r.items():
74	            if v not in (None, "", "null") and (cur.get(k) in (None, "") or k == "is_active" and v is False):
75	                cur[k] = v
76	    return out

79	def required_stroke(req: dict, mail: dict, current_revision: str) -> Decimal | None:
80	    stroke = num(req.get("stroke"))
81	    if stroke is None or req.get("stroke_kind") != "usable":
82	        return stroke
83	    releases = (mail or {}).get("technical_release") or {}
84	    key = norm_ref(req.get("reserve_key"))
85	    match = releases.get(key) if key else None
86	    if match is None:
87	        same_rev = [r for r in releases.values() if norm_ref(r.get("revision")) == norm_ref(current_revision)]
88	        match = same_rev[0] if len(same_rev) == 1 else None
89	    reserve = num((match or {}).get("reserve_mm_per_end"))
90	    return stroke + 2 * reserve if reserve is not None else None
91	
92	
93	def match_positions(tender: dict, requirements: dict, materials: dict, mail: dict, current: str) -> dict:
94	    out = {}
95	    for p in (tender or {}).get("positions") or []:
96	        pos = str(p.get("position")).strip()
97	        ref = next((r for r in requirements if norm_ref(r) == norm_ref(p.get("requirement_ref"))), None)
98	        req = requirements.get(ref) if ref else None
99	        if not req:
100	            out[pos] = {"material": None, "reason": f"requirement {p.get('requirement_ref')} not found", "candidates": []}
101	            continue
102	        stroke = required_stroke(req, mail, current)
103	        group = norm_ref(req.get("kataloggruppe"))
104	        cands = []
105	        for m in materials.values():
106	            if group and norm_ref(m.get("kataloggruppe")) and norm_ref(m.get("kataloggruppe")) != group:
107	                continue
108	            ok = (same(m.get("bore"), req.get("bore")) and stroke is not None and num(m.get("stroke")) == stroke
109	                  and same(m.get("pressure"), req.get("pressure")) and text_equal(m.get("mounting"), req.get("mounting"))
110	                  and text_equal(m.get("certification"), req.get("certification")))
111	            if ok:
112	                active = m.get("is_active")
113	                cands.append({"material": m["material"], "status": m.get("status_code"),
114	                              "active": True if active in (True, "true") else False if active in (False, "false") else None})
115	        active = [c for c in cands if c["active"] is True]
116	        unknown = [c for c in cands if c["active"] is None]       # status page not read: better than nothing
117	        required = {k: req.get(k) for k in ("bore", "pressure", "mounting", "certification", "kataloggruppe")}
118	        required["stroke"] = None if stroke is None else format(stroke.normalize(), "f")
119	        chosen = active or unknown
120	        out[pos] = {"material": chosen[0]["material"] if chosen else None, "required": required, "candidates": cands,
121	                    "reason": "exact active match" if active else "exact match, status not read" if unknown else
122	                    ("only blocked matches" if cands else "no exact match among the ERP records read")}
123	    return out
124

126	@register
127	class MaterialMatcher(Agent):
128	    phase = Phase.COLLECT
129	
130	    async def run(self) -> None:
131	        await self.ctx.board.wait_for(key="done.erp", timeout=max(1.0, self.ctx.time_left()))
132	        blocks = [page_block(e) for e in pages(self.ctx, "erp")]
133	        if not blocks:
134	            raise RuntimeError("no ERP pages were saved")
135	        mats, conds, stock_out = await asyncio.gather(
136	            extract(self.ctx, MATERIAL_INSTRUCTION, MATERIAL_SHAPE, blocks, list_key="materials", chunk_size=25_000),
137	            extract(self.ctx, CONDITION_INSTRUCTION, CONDITION_SHAPE, blocks, list_key="conditions", chunk_size=25_000),
138	            extract(self.ctx, STOCK_INSTRUCTION, STOCK_SHAPE, blocks, list_key="stock", chunk_size=25_000))
139	        materials = merge_materials(mats.get("materials") or [])
140	        stock: dict = {}
141	        for s in stock_out.get("stock") or []:           # one row per (material, location); a re-read replaces
142	            stock.setdefault(norm_ref(s.get("material")), {})[norm_ref(s.get("location")) or norm_ref(s.get("plant"))] = s
143	        for no, rows in list(stock.items()):
144	            free = sum((num(s.get("quantity")) or Decimal(0) for s in rows.values()
145	                        if str(s.get("usable")).lower() in ("true", "1", "yes")), Decimal(0))
146	            stock[no] = {"free": free, "locations": list(rows.values())}
147	        erp = {"materials": materials, "conditions": conds.get("conditions") or [],
148	               "stock": {k: {"free": format(v["free"], "f"), "locations": v["locations"]} for k, v in stock.items()}}
149	        await self.ctx.board.set("erp", erp)
150	        try:
151	            await self.ctx.board.wait_for(key="requirements_final", timeout=max(1.0, min(90, self.ctx.time_left())))
152	            await self.ctx.board.wait_for(key="mail", timeout=max(1.0, min(90, self.ctx.time_left())))  # end reserves
153	        except TimeoutError:
154	            self.log.warning("matching without final requirements or mail")
155	        mail =self.ctx.board.get("mail") or {}
156	        spec = self.ctx.board.get("spec") or {}
157	        result = match_positions(self.ctx.board.get("tender") or {}, self.ctx.board.get("requirements") or {},
158	                                 materials, mail, spec.get("current", ""))
159	        await self.ctx.board.set("materials", result)
160	        self.log.info("materials: %s", {p: (r["material"], r["reason"]) for p, r in result.items()})

# OWNER: (name)   ROLE: analyst   NEEDS: erp.page (done.erp), results["requirements"], results["tender"], results["mail"]
# WRITES: results["erp"], results["materials"]
"""Turns the saved ERP pages into materials, price conditions and stock, then matches each position in code:
an ACTIVE material whose bore, stroke, pressure, mounting and certification all equal the requirement exactly.
A requirement given as usable travel (nutzbarer Weg) gets twice the per-end reserve of the technical release for the
current revision added (amendments were already applied by the requirement analyst).

results["erp"] = {"materials": {no: {...}}, "conditions": [{...}], "stock": {no: {"free": "12", "locations": [...]}}}
results["materials"] = {position: {"material": no | None, "required": {...}, "candidates": [...], "reason": str}}
"""
import asyncio
import re
from decimal import Decimal

from swarm import Agent, Phase, register
from swarm.extract import extract, page_block, pages
from swarm.normalize import norm_ref, to_decimal

MATERIAL_SHAPE = """{"materials": [{"material": "material number", "description": "", "kataloggruppe": "",
  "bore": "", "stroke": "", "pressure": "", "mounting": "", "certification": "",
  "status_code": "as shown", "status_meaning": "meaning from the legend/tooltip",
  "is_active": "true/false from the status and its legend, or null if no status is shown for this material",
  "lead_time_stock_weeks": "", "lead_time_production_weeks": "", "pieces_per_carton": "",
  "allocation_mass_g": "allocation/Umlage weight per piece in g", "surcharge_mass_g": "surcharge mass per piece in g",
  "metal_index": "price index code"}]}"""

CONDITION_SHAPE = """{"conditions": [{"material": "", "record": "condition record no./page", "condition_type": "",
  "valid_from": "as shown", "valid_to": "as shown", "currency": "", "fx_key": null,
  "price_unit": "price unit quantity, e.g. 100", "number_format": "e.g. en-US or de-DE if stated",
  "scales": [{"min_qty": "as shown incl. locale marker", "price": "as shown incl. locale marker"}]}]}"""

STOCK_SHAPE = """{"stock": [{"material": "", "plant": "", "location": "", "quantity": "as shown",
  "usable": "true if freely usable (unrestricted), false if blocked/quality inspection/not available"}]}"""

MATERIAL_INSTRUCTION = ("List every ERP material on these pages with all its attributes (merge the tabs of one "
                        "material). is_active is true only if the status legend says released/active (not blocked).")
CONDITION_INSTRUCTION = ("List every price condition record on these pages with all quantity-scale rows. Keep the "
                         "number strings exactly with their locale markers; note the stated number format.")
STOCK_INSTRUCTION = ("List stock quantities per material and storage location shown on these pages. A plant total "
                     "that includes blocked/inspection stock is NOT usable; mark usable=true only for freely usable "
                     "storage-location stock.")


def num(text, locale=None) -> Decimal | None:
    return to_decimal(text, locale)


def same(a, b) -> bool:
    x, y = num(a), num(b)
    if x is not None and y is not None:
        return x == y
    return norm_ref(a) == norm_ref(b) and norm_ref(a) != ""


_NONE = re.compile(r"^(KEINE?|NONE|OHNE|NICHT|N/?A|—|-|–)")


def text_equal(a, b) -> bool:
    """Equal after normalisation; 'none required' and 'none' count as the same (no certification)."""
    x, y = norm_ref(a), norm_ref(b)
    if _NONE.match(x) and _NONE.match(y):
        return True
    return x == y and x != ""


def merge_materials(rows: list[dict]) -> dict:
    out: dict = {}
    for r in rows:
        no = norm_ref(r.get("material"))
        if not no:
            continue
        cur = out.setdefault(no, {"material": str(r.get("material")).strip()})
        for k, v in r.items():
            if v not in (None, "", "null") and (cur.get(k) in (None, "") or k == "is_active" and v is False):
                cur[k] = v
    return out


def required_stroke(req: dict, mail: dict, current_revision: str) -> Decimal | None:
    stroke = num(req.get("stroke"))
    if stroke is None or req.get("stroke_kind") != "usable":
        return stroke
    releases = (mail or {}).get("technical_release") or {}
    key = norm_ref(req.get("reserve_key"))
    match = releases.get(key) if key else None
    if match is None:
        same_rev = [r for r in releases.values() if norm_ref(r.get("revision")) == norm_ref(current_revision)]
        match = same_rev[0] if len(same_rev) == 1 else None
    reserve = num((match or {}).get("reserve_mm_per_end"))
    return stroke + 2 * reserve if reserve is not None else None


def match_positions(tender: dict, requirements: dict, materials: dict, mail: dict, current: str) -> dict:
    out = {}
    for p in (tender or {}).get("positions") or []:
        pos = str(p.get("position")).strip()
        ref = next((r for r in requirements if norm_ref(r) == norm_ref(p.get("requirement_ref"))), None)
        req = requirements.get(ref) if ref else None
        if not req:
            out[pos] = {"material": None, "reason": f"requirement {p.get('requirement_ref')} not found", "candidates": []}
            continue
        stroke = required_stroke(req, mail, current)
        group = norm_ref(req.get("kataloggruppe"))
        cands = []
        for m in materials.values():
            if group and norm_ref(m.get("kataloggruppe")) and norm_ref(m.get("kataloggruppe")) != group:
                continue
            ok = (same(m.get("bore"), req.get("bore")) and stroke is not None and num(m.get("stroke")) == stroke
                  and same(m.get("pressure"), req.get("pressure")) and text_equal(m.get("mounting"), req.get("mounting"))
                  and text_equal(m.get("certification"), req.get("certification")))
            if ok:
                active = m.get("is_active")
                cands.append({"material": m["material"], "status": m.get("status_code"),
                              "active": True if active in (True, "true") else False if active in (False, "false") else None})
        active = [c for c in cands if c["active"] is True]
        unknown = [c for c in cands if c["active"] is None]       # status page not read: better than nothing
        required = {k: req.get(k) for k in ("bore", "pressure", "mounting", "certification", "kataloggruppe")}
        required["stroke"] = None if stroke is None else format(stroke.normalize(), "f")
        chosen = active or unknown
        out[pos] = {"material": chosen[0]["material"] if chosen else None, "required": required, "candidates": cands,
                    "reason": "exact active match" if active else "exact match, status not read" if unknown else
                    ("only blocked matches" if cands else "no exact match among the ERP records read")}
    return out


@register
class MaterialMatcher(Agent):
    phase = Phase.COLLECT

    async def run(self) -> None:
        await self.ctx.board.wait_for(key="done.erp", timeout=max(1.0, self.ctx.time_left()))
        blocks = [page_block(e) for e in pages(self.ctx, "erp")]
        if not blocks:
            raise RuntimeError("no ERP pages were saved")
        mats, conds, stock_out = await asyncio.gather(
            extract(self.ctx, MATERIAL_INSTRUCTION, MATERIAL_SHAPE, blocks, list_key="materials", chunk_size=25_000),
            extract(self.ctx, CONDITION_INSTRUCTION, CONDITION_SHAPE, blocks, list_key="conditions", chunk_size=25_000),
            extract(self.ctx, STOCK_INSTRUCTION, STOCK_SHAPE, blocks, list_key="stock", chunk_size=25_000))
        materials = merge_materials(mats.get("materials") or [])
        stock: dict = {}
        for s in stock_out.get("stock") or []:           # one row per (material, location); a re-read replaces
            stock.setdefault(norm_ref(s.get("material")), {})[norm_ref(s.get("location")) or norm_ref(s.get("plant"))] = s
        for no, rows in list(stock.items()):
            free = sum((num(s.get("quantity")) or Decimal(0) for s in rows.values()
                        if str(s.get("usable")).lower() in ("true", "1", "yes")), Decimal(0))
            stock[no] = {"free": free, "locations": list(rows.values())}
        erp = {"materials": materials, "conditions": conds.get("conditions") or [],
               "stock": {k: {"free": format(v["free"], "f"), "locations": v["locations"]} for k, v in stock.items()}}
        await self.ctx.board.set("erp", erp)
        try:
            await self.ctx.board.wait_for(key="requirements_final", timeout=max(1.0, min(90, self.ctx.time_left())))
            await self.ctx.board.wait_for(key="mail", timeout=max(1.0, min(90, self.ctx.time_left())))  # end reserves
        except TimeoutError:
            self.log.warning("matching without final requirements or mail")
        mail =self.ctx.board.get("mail") or {}
        spec = self.ctx.board.get("spec") or {}
        result = match_positions(self.ctx.board.get("tender") or {}, self.ctx.board.get("requirements") or {},
                                 materials, mail, spec.get("current", ""))
        await self.ctx.board.set("materials", result)
        self.log.info("materials: %s", {p: (r["material"], r["reason"]) for p, r in result.items()})

# OWNER: (name)   ROLE: analyst   NEEDS: tender.page (done.tender)   WRITES: results["tender"], results["quantities"]
"""Turns the saved tender pages into positions and Q&A records, then applies the quantity rules in code.

results["tender"] = {
  "meta": {"reference", "deadline", ...},
  "positions": [{"position", "short_text", "quantity" (as shown), "unit", "requirement_ref"}],
  "clarifications": [{"number", "date", "kind", "positions": [...], "new_quantity", "withdraws": [...],
                      "amendment": {...} | null, "keys": {...}, "setup_fee": str | null, "text"}]
}
results["quantities"] = {position: {"quantity": int (in the position's unit), "unit": str, "basis": str}}
Rule: tender quantity, overridden by the latest dated clarification that changes it; withdrawn answers are ignored.
"""
import asyncio

from swarm import Agent, Phase, register
from swarm.extract import extract, page_block, pages
from swarm.normalize import norm_ref, to_datetime, to_int

POSITIONS_SHAPE = """{"meta": {"reference": "", "title": "", "deadline": "", "timezone": ""},
 "positions": [{"position": "position number as shown", "short_text": "", "quantity": "as shown", "unit": "",
                "requirement_ref": "requirement reference as shown"}]}"""

QA_SHAPE = """{"clarifications": [{
  "number": "Q&A number", "date": "UTC ISO timestamp if shown, else as shown", "question": "", "answer": "full answer text",
  "kind": "quantity_change | withdrawal | technical_amendment | commercial_keys | setup_fee | other",
  "positions": ["position numbers this answer applies to"],
  "new_quantity": "new total quantity as shown, or null", "quantity_unit": "unit of that quantity or null",
  "withdraws": ["numbers of earlier answers this one EXPLICITLY withdraws/retracts (zurückgezogen); a newer value replacing an older one is not a withdrawal"],
  "amendment": {"document": "", "revision": "", "requirement": "", "attribute": "", "value": ""} or null,
  "keys": {"konditionsgruppe": null, "packaging_tariff": null, "delivery_key": null, "setup_pool": null, "bonus_plan": null},
  "setup_fee": "one-off setup cost amount as shown, or null"}]}"""


def withdrawn_numbers(clarifications: list[dict]) -> set[str]:
    """Numbers of answers explicitly withdrawn by a withdrawal answer (a newer value is not a withdrawal)."""
    return {norm_ref(n) for c in clarifications if c.get("kind") == "withdrawal" for n in (c.get("withdraws") or [])}


def final_quantities(positions: list[dict], clarifications: list[dict]) -> dict:
    withdrawn = withdrawn_numbers(clarifications)
    out = {}
    for p in positions:
        pos = str(p.get("position") or "").strip()
        if not pos:
            continue
        qty, basis = to_int(p.get("quantity")), "tender"
        changes = [c for c in clarifications
                   if c.get("new_quantity") not in (None, "") and norm_ref(c.get("number")) not in withdrawn
                   and pos in [str(x).strip() for x in (c.get("positions") or [])]]
        changes.sort(key=lambda c: (to_datetime(c.get("date")) is not None, to_datetime(c.get("date")) or 0,
                                    to_int(c.get("number")) or 0))
        if changes:
            latest = changes[-1]
            qty, basis = to_int(latest.get("new_quantity")), f"Q&A {latest.get('number')}"
        out[pos] = {"quantity": qty, "unit": p.get("unit"), "basis": basis}
    return out


@register
class QuantityAnalyzer(Agent):
    phase = Phase.COLLECT        # runs as soon as the tender scraper is done, while the other sites are still read

    async def run(self) -> None:
        await self.ctx.board.wait_for(key="done.tender", timeout=max(1.0, self.ctx.time_left()))
        blocks = [page_block(e) for e in pages(self.ctx, "tender")]
        if not blocks:
            raise RuntimeError("no tender pages were saved")
        ref = (self.ctx.board.get("brief") or {}).get("tender_reference", "")
        pos_out, qa_out = await asyncio.gather(
            extract(self.ctx, "List the tender's positions from the bill of quantities / position overview "
                              "(original tender quantities, not Q&A changes).", POSITIONS_SHAPE, blocks),
            extract(self.ctx, f"List EVERY bidder Q&A entry for tender {ref} (all pages). Classify each answer.",
                    QA_SHAPE, blocks, list_key="clarifications"))
        positions = [p for p in (pos_out or {}).get("positions", []) if p.get("position")]
        seen, clarifications = set(), []
        for c in qa_out.get("clarifications", []):
            key = norm_ref(c.get("number")) or norm_ref(c.get("question"))
            if key and key not in seen:
                seen.add(key)
                clarifications.append(c)
        tender = {"meta": (pos_out or {}).get("meta", {}), "positions": positions, "clarifications": clarifications}
        await self.ctx.board.set("tender", tender)
        quantities = final_quantities(positions, clarifications)
        await self.ctx.board.set("quantities", quantities)
        self.log.info("%d positions, %d Q&A, quantities %s", len(positions), len(clarifications), quantities)

9	It is written up to three times: early, as soon as a requirement table page is saved (so the ERP search can start

20	               "is_current": true/false}],

22	   "bore": "number as shown incl. locale marker", "stroke": "number as shown incl. locale marker",
23	   "stroke_kind": "nominal, or usable if the stroke is a usable travel (nutzbarer Weg) that needs end reserves",
24	   "pressure": "number as shown incl. locale marker", "mounting": "", "certification": "",
25	   "kataloggruppe": "catalogue group to search in the ERP", "pieces_per_set": "pieces per set (Satz) if stated, else null",
26	   "reserve_key": "technical release / end reserve key if referenced, else null",
27	   "original_text": "the requirement's original wording if shown"}]}"""

29	NUMERIC = ("bore", "stroke", "pressure")

32	def plain_number(text) -> str | None:
33	    value = to_decimal(text)
34	    return None if value is None else format(value.normalize(), "f")

37	def apply_amendments(requirements: dict, current: str, clarifications: list[dict]) -> dict:
38	    """Latest dated amendment per (requirement, attribute) that names the current revision; other revisions ignored."""
39	    fields = {"bore": ("bohrung", "bore", "durchmesser"), "stroke": ("hub", "stroke", "stellweg", "weg"),
40	              "pressure": ("druck", "pressure"), "mounting": ("befestigung", "mounting"),
41	              "certification": ("zertifi", "certification", "prüf")}
42	    amendments = sorted((c for c in clarifications if c.get("amendment")),
43	                        key=lambda c: to_datetime(c.get("date")) or to_datetime("1970-01-01"))
44	    for c in amendments:
45	        a = c["amendment"]
46	        if norm_ref(a.get("revision")) != norm_ref(current):
47	            continue
48	        req = requirements.get(next((r for r in requirements if norm_ref(r) == norm_ref(a.get("requirement"))), ""))
49	        attr = next((f for f, words in fields.items() if any(w in (a.get("attribute") or "").lower() for w in words)), None)
50	        if req is None or attr is None or a.get("value") in (None, ""):
51	            continue
52	        req[attr] = plain_number(a["value"]) if attr in NUMERIC else str(a["value"]).strip()
53	        req.setdefault("amended", []).append(f"{attr} by Q&A {c.get('number')} ({c.get('date')})")
54	    return requirements
55

57	@register
58	class RequirementAnalyzer(Agent):
59	    phase = Phase.COLLECT
60	
61	    async def run(self) -> None:
62	        early = asyncio.create_task(self.early())
63	        try:
64	            await self.ctx.board.wait_for(key="done.spec", timeout=max(1.0, self.ctx.time_left()))
65	        finally:
66	            if not early.done():
67	                early.cancel()
68	        if not pages(self.ctx, "spec"):
69	            raise RuntimeError("no specification pages were saved")
70	        revisions, current, requirements = await self.analyse()
71	        await self.ctx.board.set("spec", {"revisions": revisions, "current": current})
72	        await self.ctx.board.set("requirements", requirements)
73	        self.log.info("current revision %s, requirements %s", current, list(requirements))
74	        tender = await self.ctx.board.wait_for(key="tender", timeout=max(1.0, self.ctx.time_left()))
75	        amended = apply_amendments({k: dict(v) for k, v in requirements.items()}, current,
76	                                   (tender or {}).get("clarifications") or [])
77	        await self.ctx.board.set("requirements", amended)
78	        await self.ctx.board.set("requirements_final", True)
79	
80	    async def early(self) -> None:
81	        """As soon as a requirement table is saved, publish a first version so the ERP search can start while the
82	        spec scraper is still finishing (the final version replaces it)."""
83	        while True:
84	            topics = " ".join(str(e.data.get("topic", "")).lower() for e in pages(self.ctx, "spec"))
85	            if "requirement" in topics or "anforderung" in topics:
86	                revisions, current, requirements = await self.analyse()
87	                if requirements and self.ctx.board.get("requirements") is None:
88	                    await self.ctx.board.set("spec", {"revisions": revisions, "current": current})
89	                    await self.ctx.board.set("requirements", requirements)
90	                    self.log.info("early requirements (%s): %s", current, list(requirements))
91	                return
92	            await asyncio.sleep(3)
93	
94	    async def analyse(self) -> tuple[list, str, dict]:
95	        blocks = [page_block(e) for e in pages(self.ctx, "spec")]
96	        out = await extract(self.ctx, "Extract the specification's revision list and the requirement rows (for every "
97	                                      "revision whose rows are on the pages). A revision is current only if its status "
98	                                      "says so (e.g. gültig/aktuell/current), never if superseded (ersetzt).",
99	                            SHAPE, blocks, list_key=("requirements", "revisions"))
100	        revisions = out.get("revisions") or []
101	        flagged = [r for r in revisions if r.get("is_current") is True]
102	        flagged.sort(key=lambda r: to_datetime(r.get("date")) or to_datetime("1970-01-01"))
103	        current = flagged[-1]["revision"] if flagged else ""
104	        rows = out.get("requirements") or []
105	        if current:
106	            rows = [r for r in rows if norm_ref(r.get("revision")) == norm_ref(current)] or rows
107	        requirements = {}
108	        for r in rows:
109	            ref = str(r.get("ref") or "").strip()
110	            if not ref:
111	                continue
112	            entry = {k: r.get(k) for k in ("mounting", "certification", "kataloggruppe", "reserve_key", "original_text")}
113	            entry |= {k: plain_number(r.get(k)) for k in NUMERIC}
114	            entry["stroke_kind"] = "usable" if "usable" in str(r.get("stroke_kind") or "").lower() else "nominal"
115	            entry["pieces_per_set"] = plain_number(r.get("pieces_per_set")) if r.get("pieces_per_set") else None
116	            entry["revision"] = r.get("revision") or current
117	            requirements.setdefault(ref, entry)

results["spec"] = {"revisions": [{"revision", "date", "status", "is_current"}], "current": "R-..."}

from swarm.normalize import norm_ref, to_datetime, to_decimal

SHAPE = """{"revisions": [{"revision": "", "date": "ISO date (mind the stated MM/DD or DD/MM order)", "status": "as shown",
               "is_current": true/false}],
 "requirements": [{"revision": "revision these values belong to", "ref": "requirement reference as shown",
   "bore": "number as shown incl. locale marker", "stroke": "number as shown incl. locale marker",
   "stroke_kind": "nominal, or usable if the stroke is a usable travel (nutzbarer Weg) that needs end reserves",
   "pressure": "number as shown incl. locale marker", "mounting": "", "certification": "",
   "kataloggruppe": "catalogue group to search in the ERP", "pieces_per_set": "pieces per set (Satz) if stated, else null",
   "reserve_key": "technical release / end reserve key if referenced, else null",
   "original_text": "the requirement's original wording if shown"}]}"""

NUMERIC = ("bore", "stroke", "pressure")


def plain_number(text) -> str | None:
    value = to_decimal(text)
    return None if value is None else format(value.normalize(), "f")


def apply_amendments(requirements: dict, current: str, clarifications: list[dict]) -> dict:
    """Latest dated amendment per (requirement, attribute) that names the current revision; other revisions ignored."""
    fields = {"bore": ("bohrung", "bore", "durchmesser"), "stroke": ("hub", "stroke", "stellweg", "weg"),
              "pressure": ("druck", "pressure"), "mounting": ("befestigung", "mounting"),
              "certification": ("zertifi", "certification", "prüf")}
    amendments = sorted((c for c in clarifications if c.get("amendment")),
                        key=lambda c: to_datetime(c.get("date")) or to_datetime("1970-01-01"))
    for c in amendments:
        a = c["amendment"]
        if norm_ref(a.get("revision")) != norm_ref(current):
            continue
        req = requirements.get(next((r for r in requirements if norm_ref(r) == norm_ref(a.get("requirement"))), ""))
        attr = next((f for f, words in fields.items() if any(w in (a.get("attribute") or "").lower() for w in words)), None)
        if req is None or attr is None or a.get("value") in (None, ""):
            continue
        req[attr] = plain_number(a["value"]) if attr in NUMERIC else str(a["value"]).strip()
        req.setdefault("amended", []).append(f"{attr} by Q&A {c.get('number')} ({c.get('date')})")
    return requirements


@register
class RequirementAnalyzer(Agent):
    phase = Phase.COLLECT

    async def run(self) -> None:
        early = asyncio.create_task(self.early())
        try:
            await self.ctx.board.wait_for(key="done.spec", timeout=max(1.0, self.ctx.time_left()))
        finally:
            if not early.done():
                early.cancel()
        if not pages(self.ctx, "spec"):
            raise RuntimeError("no specification pages were saved")
        revisions, current, requirements = await self.analyse()
        await self.ctx.board.set("spec", {"revisions": revisions, "current": current})
        await self.ctx.board.set("requirements", requirements)
        self.log.info("current revision %s, requirements %s", current, list(requirements))
        tender = await self.ctx.board.wait_for(key="tender", timeout=max(1.0, self.ctx.time_left()))
        amended = apply_amendments({k: dict(v) for k, v in requirements.items()}, current,
                                   (tender or {}).get("clarifications") or [])
        await self.ctx.board.set("requirements", amended)
        await self.ctx.board.set("requirements_final", True)

    async def early(self) -> None:
        """As soon as a requirement table is saved, publish a first version so the ERP search can start while the
        spec scraper is still finishing (the final version replaces it)."""
        while True:
            topics = " ".join(str(e.data.get("topic", "")).lower() for e in pages(self.ctx, "spec"))
            if "requirement" in topics or "anforderung" in topics:
                revisions, current, requirements = await self.analyse()
                if requirements and self.ctx.board.get("requirements") is None:
                    await self.ctx.board.set("spec", {"revisions": revisions, "current": current})
                    await self.ctx.board.set("requirements", requirements)
                    self.log.info("early requirements (%s): %s", current, list(requirements))
                return
            await asyncio.sleep(3)

    async def analyse(self) -> tuple[list, str, dict]:
        blocks = [page_block(e) for e in pages(self.ctx, "spec")]
        out = await extract(self.ctx, "Extract the specification's revision list and the requirement rows (for every "
                                      "revision whose rows are on the pages). A revision is current only if its status "
                                      "says so (e.g. gültig/aktuell/current), never if superseded (ersetzt).",
                            SHAPE, blocks, list_key=("requirements", "revisions"))
        revisions = out.get("revisions") or []
        flagged = [r for r in revisions if r.get("is_current") is True]
        flagged.sort(key=lambda r: to_datetime(r.get("date")) or to_datetime("1970-01-01"))
        current = flagged[-1]["revision"] if flagged else ""
        rows = out.get("requirements") or []
        if current:
            rows = [r for r in rows if norm_ref(r.get("revision")) == norm_ref(current)] or rows
        requirements = {}
        for r in rows:
            ref = str(r.get("ref") or "").strip()
            if not ref:
                continue
            entry = {k: r.get(k) for k in ("mounting", "certification", "kataloggruppe", "reserve_key", "original_text")}
            entry |= {k: plain_number(r.get(k)) for k in NUMERIC}
            entry["stroke_kind"] = "usable" if "usable" in str(r.get("stroke_kind") or "").lower() else "nominal"
            entry["pieces_per_set"] = plain_number(r.get("pieces_per_set")) if r.get("pieces_per_set") else None
            entry["revision"] = r.get("revision") or current
            requirements.setdefault(ref, entry)
        return revisions, current, requirements

"""Reads the brief once at the start so every agent knows the tender reference, scenario date and bidder data.

results["brief"] = {
  "tender_reference": str, "tender_title": str, "buyer": str, "scenario_date": ISO str, "deadline": str,
  "bidder_company": str, "bidder_vat_id": str, "director_sender": str (sender local part),
  "currency": str
}
The reference is only accepted if it literally occurs in the brief (no model invention).
"""
import asyncio

from swarm import Agent, Phase, register
from swarm.normalize import norm_ref, to_datetime
from swarm.sites import resolve_roles

SHAPE = """{"tender_reference": "", "tender_title": "", "buyer": "", "scenario_date": "ISO 8601 with timezone",
"deadline": "", "bidder_company": "", "bidder_vat_id": "", "currency": "",
"director_sender": "local part of the sender who approves discounts, e.g. 'name@'",
"discount_topic": "German word for the discount approval topic",
"authorized_senders": {"<one of: discount_approval, condition_rules, technical_release, packaging_tariffs,
  delivery_commitments, setup_pools, project_bonus, fx_fixing, price_indices>": "<sender local part the brief names for it>"},
"mail_topics": ["every mail subject/topic word the brief says carries release data (e.g. condition rules, price indices)"]}"""


@register
class BriefReader(Agent):
    phase = Phase.COLLECT

    async def run(self) -> None:
        roles = asyncio.create_task(resolve_roles(self.ctx))     # in parallel with the brief call
        facts = await self.ctx.llm.ask_json(
            "Extract key facts from this task brief. Copy values exactly. Reply JSON only.",
            f"Shape:\n{SHAPE}\n\nBRIEF:\n{self.ctx.brief}")
        facts = {k: (v.strip() if isinstance(v, str) else v) for k, v in (facts or {}).items()}
        if norm_ref(facts.get("tender_reference")) not in norm_ref(self.ctx.brief):
            self.log.warning("reference %r not in brief; dropped", facts.get("tender_reference"))
            facts["tender_reference"] = ""
        if facts.get("scenario_date") and not to_datetime(facts["scenario_date"]):
            facts["scenario_date"] = ""
        await self.ctx.board.set("brief", facts)
        self.log.info("brief facts: %s", facts)
        await roles

async def start(self) -> None:
		"""Start the browser session."""
		start_event = self.event_bus.dispatch(BrowserStartEvent())
		await start_event
		# Ensure any exceptions from the event handler are propagated
		await start_event.event_result(raise_if_any=True, raise_if_none=False)

	async def kill(self) -> None:
		"""Kill the browser session and reset all state."""
		self._intentional_stop = True
		self.logger.debug('🛑 kill() called - stopping browser with force=True and resetting state')

		# First save storage state while CDP is still connected
		from browser_use.browser.events import SaveStorageStateEvent

		save_event = self.event_bus.dispatch(SaveStorageStateEvent())
		await save_event

		# Dispatch stop event to kill the browser
		await self.event_bus.dispatch(BrowserStopEvent(force=True))
		# Stop the event bus
		await self.event_bus.stop(clear=True, timeout=5)
		# Reset all state
		await self.reset()
		# Create fresh event bus
		self.event_bus = EventBus()

	async def stop(self) -> None:
		"""Stop the browser session without killing the browser process.

		This clears event buses and cached state but keeps the browser alive.
		Useful when you want to clean up resources but plan to reconnect later.
		"""
		self._intentional_stop = True
		self.logger.debug('⏸️  stop() called - stopping browser gracefully (force=False) and resetting state')

		# First save storage state while CDP is still connected
		from browser_use.browser.events import SaveStorageStateEvent

		save_event = self.event_bus.dispatch(SaveStorageStateEvent())
		await save_event

		# Now dispatch BrowserStopEvent to notify watchdogs
		await self.event_bus.dispatch(BrowserStopEvent(force=False))

		# Stop the event bus
		await self.event_bus.stop(clear=True, timeout=5)
		# Reset all state
		await self.reset()
		# Create fresh event bus
		self.event_bus = EventBus()

"""The run's browsers: attach over CDP and get a page. Driving them is up to you.

In a run the sandbox starts the browsers (agent.json "browsers": 1 to 4, default 1) before the clock starts and sets
CDP_URL (browser 1) and CDP_URLS (all of them, as a JSON array). Use those: the sandbox stops browsers your agent
starts itself. On your own machine there is no CDP_URLS, so `connect` starts a local Chromium (once:
`uv run playwright install chromium`; HEADLESS=1 hides it). Docs: $API/docs/building-an-agent.md
"""
import json
import os


def cdp_urls(env=os.environ) -> list[str]:
    """Every browser of the run, in order; [] on your own machine."""
    try:
        urls = [url for url in json.loads(env.get("CDP_URLS") or "[]") if isinstance(url, str)]
    except ValueError:
        urls = []
    return urls or ([env["CDP_URL"]] if env.get("CDP_URL") else [])

"""The run's browsers: attach over CDP and get a page. Driving them is up to you.

In a run the sandbox starts the browsers (agent.json "browsers": 1 to 4, default 1) before the clock starts and sets
CDP_URL (browser 1) and CDP_URLS (all of them, as a JSON array). Use those: the sandbox stops browsers your agent
starts itself. On your own machine there is no CDP_URLS, so `connect` starts a local Chromium (once:
`uv run playwright install chromium`; HEADLESS=1 hides it). Docs: $API/docs/building-an-agent.md
"""
import json
import os


def cdp_urls(env=os.environ) -> list[str]:
    """Every browser of the run, in order; [] on your own machine."""
    try:
        urls = [url for url in json.loads(env.get("CDP_URLS") or "[]") if isinstance(url, str)]
    except ValueError:
        urls = []
    return urls or ([env["CDP_URL"]] if env.get("CDP_URL") else [])


async def connect(playwright, number: int = 0):
    """Browser `number` of the run (0 is browser 1) and a page in it. Locally, a Chromium of its own."""
    urls = cdp_urls()
    if urls:
        browser = await playwright.chromium.connect_over_cdp(urls[number])
        context = browser.contexts[0] if browser.contexts else await browser.new_context()
    else:
        browser = await playwright.chromium.launch(headless=os.environ.get("HEADLESS") == "1")
        context = await browser.new_context()
    page = context.pages[0] if context.pages else await context.new_page()
    return browser, page

_stopping: bool = PrivateAttr(default=False)

	async def on_BrowserStopEvent(self, event: BrowserStopEvent) -> None:
		"""Handle browser stop request - stop creating new tabs."""
		# logger.info('[AboutBlankWatchdog] Browser stop requested, stopping tab creation')
		self._stopping = True

	async def on_BrowserStoppedEvent(self, event: BrowserStoppedEvent) -> None:
		"""Handle browser stopped event."""
		# logger.info('[AboutBlankWatchdog] Browser stopped')
		self._stopping = True

	async def on_TabCreatedEvent(self, event: TabCreatedEvent) -> None:
		"""Check tabs when a new tab is created."""
		# logger.debug(f'[AboutBlankWatchdog] ➕ New tab created: {event.url}')

		# If an about:blank tab was created, show DVD screensaver on all about:blank tabs
		if event.url == 'about:blank':
			await self._show_dvd_screensaver_on_about_blank_tabs()

	async def on_TabClosedEvent(self, event: TabClosedEvent) -> None:
		"""Check tabs when a tab is closed and proactively create about:blank if needed."""
		# Don't create new tabs if browser is shutting down
		if self._stopping:
			return

		# Don't attempt CDP operations if the WebSocket is dead — dispatching
		# NavigateToUrlEvent on a broken connection will hang until timeout
		if not self.browser_session.is_cdp_connected:
			self.logger.debug('[AboutBlankWatchdog] CDP not connected, skipping tab recovery')
			return

		# Check if we're about to close the last tab (event happens BEFORE tab closes)
		# Use _cdp_get_all_pages for quick check without fetching titles
		page_targets = await self.browser_session._cdp_get_all_pages()
		if len(page_targets) < 1:
			self.logger.debug(
				'[AboutBlankWatchdog] Last tab closing, creating new about:blank tab to avoid closing entire browser'
			)
			# Create the animation tab since no tabs should remain
			navigate_event = self.event_bus.dispatch(NavigateToUrlEvent(url='about:blank', new_tab=True))
			await navigate_event
			# Show DVD screensaver on the new tab
			await self._show_dvd_screensaver_on_about_blank_tabs()
		else:
			# Multiple tabs exist, check after close
			await self._check_and_ensure_about_blank_tab()

	async def attach_to_target(self, target_id: TargetID) -> None:
		"""AboutBlankWatchdog doesn't monitor individual targets."""
		pass

	async def _check_and_ensure_about_blank_tab(self) -> None:
		"""Check current tabs and ensure exactly one about:blank tab with animation exists."""
		try:
			if not self.browser_session.is_cdp_connected:
				return

			# For quick checks, just get page targets without titles to reduce noise
			page_targets = await self.browser_session._cdp_get_all_pages()

			# If no tabs exist at all, create one to keep browser alive
			if len(page_targets) == 0:
				# Only create a new tab if there are no tabs at all
				self.logger.debug('[AboutBlankWatchdog] No tabs exist, creating new about:blank DVD screensaver tab')
				navigate_event = self.event_bus.dispatch(NavigateToUrlEvent(url='about:blank', new_tab=True))
				await navigate_event
				# Show DVD screensaver on the new tab
				await self._show_dvd_screensaver_on_about_blank_tabs()
			# Otherwise there are tabs, don't create new ones to avoid interfering

		except Exception as e:
			self.logger.error(f'[AboutBlankWatchdog] Error ensuring about:blank tab: {e}')

	async def _show_dvd_screensaver_on_about_blank_tabs(self) -> None:
		"""Show DVD screensaver on all about:blank pages only."""
		try:
			# Get just the page targets without expensive title fetching
			page_targets = await self.browser_session._cdp_get_all_pages()
			browser_session_label = str(self.browser_session.id)[-4:]

Tabs: a browser holds any number of tabs, and every browse() runs in a tab of its own (`Tab`): by default the browser's
main tab, or a tab you open with `Tab(browser)` (`await tab.close()` when its work is done). Tabs of one browser share
its cookies, so a tab opened after a login is logged in too. Rule: ONE browse() at a time per tab; parallel agents use
different tabs. An agent only sees its own tab and tabs nobody owns (e.g. a popup it opened), never another agent's.

Flash mode (default): the browsing model replies with a short memory and its actions only, no separate thinking /
evaluation / next-goal fields, and gets a compact system prompt. `flash=False` keeps browser-use's full reasoning prompt
for agents whose decisions are costly to get wrong (the bid submitter).

Per-site knowledge goes into `goal`/`hints` as general strategy, never scenario values.
"""
import asyncio
import json
import logging
import os
from typing import Any
from urllib.parse import urljoin, urlparse, urlunparse

async def _browser_ws(cdp_url: str) -> str:
    """The browser's WebSocket debugger URL (CDP_URLS may hold http URLs, as browser-use itself accepts)."""
    if cdp_url.startswith("ws"):
        return cdp_url
    parts = urlparse(cdp_url)
    path = parts.path.rstrip("/")
    path = path if path.endswith("/json/version") else path + "/json/version"
    async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=30) as client:
        reply = await client.get(urlunparse((parts.scheme, parts.netloc, path, "", "", "")))
        return reply.json()["webSocketDebuggerUrl"]


async def _with_cdp(browser: int, call):
    client = CDPClient(await _browser_ws(browsers.cdp_urls()[browser % len(browsers.cdp_urls())]))
    await client.start()
    try:
        return await call(client)
    finally:
        await client.stop()


class Tab:
    """One tab of browser `browser`, owned by one agent (one browse() at a time). `Tab(b)` is a new tab, opened at the
    first browse(); `main_tab(b)` is the tab the browser started with. Locally (no CDP) every browse() starts its own
    Chromium, so a Tab is only a label there."""

    def __init__(self, browser: int, main: bool = False):
        self.browser, self.main = browser, main
        self.target_id: str | None = None

    def claim(self, target_id: str) -> None:
        self.target_id = target_id
        _OWNERS[target_id] = self

    async def open(self) -> None:
        """Create the tab now (before the session connects) so no other agent ever sees it unowned."""
        if self.target_id or self.main or not browsers.cdp_urls():
            return
        made = await _with_cdp(self.browser, lambda c: c.send.Target.createTarget(
            params={"url": "about:blank", "background": True}))
        self.claim(made["targetId"])

    async def close(self) -> None:
        """Close the tab (never the browser's main tab)."""
        target, self.target_id = self.target_id, None
        if not target or self.main:
            return
        _OWNERS.pop(target, None)
        try:
            await _with_cdp(self.browser, lambda c: c.send.Target.closeTarget(params={"targetId": target}))
        except Exception as error:      # already closed / browser gone
            log.debug("closing tab failed: %s", error)


def main_tab(browser: int) -> Tab:
    return _MAIN_TABS.setdefault(browser, Tab(browser, main=True))


_all_page_targets = SessionManager.get_all_page_targets

    """What a session sees as "the browser's tabs": its own tab first, then tabs nobody owns (popups); never the tabs
    of other agents. browser-use derives its tab list, focus and new-tab reuse from this."""
    targets = _all_page_targets(self)
    tab = getattr(self.browser_session, "_tab", None)
    if tab is None:
        return targets
    return ([t for t in targets if t.target_id == tab.target_id]
            + [t for t in targets if t.target_id != tab.target_id and t.target_id not in _OWNERS])


SessionManager.get_all_page_targets = _visible_page_targets
